title: A. Source fidelity
definition: Every claim on the canvas means what the source means: qualifiers, conditions, causes, numbers, identifiers and named entities are preserved, and nothing the source doesn't support is added.
questions: Are causal relationships and conditions preserved (no widened condition, no swapped cause and effect, no correlation stated as causation)?
Are numerical values, formulas, identifiers and named entities exactly right?
Are unsupported claims introduced (absolutes, invented numbers, recommendations the source doesn't make)?
Are critical caveats or exceptions omitted?

severity.critical: A meaning change a reader would act on: a possibility made a guarantee, a condition or exception dropped, a cause reversed, a wrong number, an invented fact.
severity.major: A weakened but not reversed qualifier; a named term changed; a hedge lost on a non-critical claim.
severity.minor: Harmless rewording that a careful reader might find slightly less precise.

deterministic: text_present on the claim's own element (condition, qualifier, exact value)
text_absent for known distortions (absolutes, invented paths/code, fabricated agreement)
future: plan §3.4 meaning rules once implemented (ai.meaning-rules)
model_judge: Card-by-card comparison with the units it represents: supported / partly / not supported, with the reason (offline, approved runs only)
human: Reviewer compares each critical card with its source units; resolves judge disagreements

requiredAssertions: At least one critical text_present per critical condition or limit
At least one text_absent per plausible distortion in mustNotClaim
One judged meaning check per case
passCriteria: Every critical deterministic fidelity assertion passes on every run, and the judged check finds no critical distortion.
failCriteria: Any critical fidelity assertion fails, or the judge/reviewer finds a critical distortion the checks missed (which then becomes a new assertion).
passExample: Source: 'Hybrid search can improve recall when lexical and semantic signals are complementary.' Card: 'Hybrid search may raise recall — if keyword and vector signals complement each other.'
failExample: Card: 'Hybrid search always improves recall.' (qualifier and condition gone: possibility → guarantee)

judgeScale.meaning: Several meaning changes or invented facts.
Meaning kept overall; one qualifier weakened or one non-critical detail off.
Every claim keeps its qualifiers, conditions, causes and exact values; nothing added.
